subject: Ciências
description_pt: Utilizar o conhecimento das formas de propagação do calor para justificar a utilização de determinados materiais (condutores e isolantes) na vida cotidiana, explicar o princípio de funcionamento de alguns equipamentos (garrafa térmica, coletor solar etc.) e/ou construir soluções tecnológicas a partir desse conhecimento.

components.description_pt: Comparar mecanismos de transferência de energia como condução, convecção e radiação
components.description_en: Compare mechanisms of energy transfer such as conduction, convection, and radiation
components.cc_component_description: Compare mechanisms of energy transfer such as conduction, convection, and radiation

components.description_pt: Classificar materiais como condutores ou isolantes térmicos com base em suas propriedades de transferência de calor
components.description_en: Classify materials as thermal conductors or insulators based on their heat-transfer properties
components.cc_component_description: Classify materials into groups based on shared observable properties such as color, texture, hardness, or flexibility

components.description_pt: Justificar a escolha de materiais específicos em objetos cotidianos utilizando conhecimento de mecanismos de transferência de calor
components.description_en: Justify the choice of specific materials in everyday objects using knowledge of heat transfer modes
components.cc_component_description: Justify the selection of a preferred design solution using evidence aligned with agreed-upon criteria

components.description_pt: Explicar os princípios de funcionamento de dispositivos térmicos usando conceitos de transferência de calor
components.description_en: Explain the operating principles of thermal devices (thermos flasks, solar collectors) using heat transfer concepts
components.cc_component_description: Apply scientific principles of thermal energy transfer to design a device that minimizes or maximizes heat flow

components.description_pt: Aplicar princípios científicos de transferência de energia térmica para projetar um dispositivo que minimize ou maximize fluxo de calor
components.description_en: Apply scientific principles of thermal energy transfer to design a device that minimizes or maximizes heat flow
components.cc_component_description: Apply scientific principles of thermal energy transfer to design a device that minimizes or maximizes heat flow

cc_matches.description: Apply scientific principles to design, construct, and test a device that either minimizes or maximizes thermal energy transfer.
Energy can be transferred in various ways and between objects.
Evaluate competing design solutions based on jointly developed and agreed-upon design criteria.
Plan and conduct an investigation to describe and classify different kinds of materials by their observable properties.
